Caveats: Trajectory retrieval uses the separate OpenSky history database; the OPDI tables must not be described as a self-contained archive of every flight track. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-bluesky, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
